name: ddd-expert
description: Strategic EventStorming, sparse Tactical Design, implementation, and review

interface.longDescription: DDD workflow that builds a compact strategic model through EventStorming, then uses a relentless one question at a time Tactical Design interview to apply the Capability Probe and maintain the current domain-object design. Codify implements accepted object slices without changing design authority, and Guard reviews the result independently.
defaultPrompt: Use $ddd-expert:event-storming to clarify the user's purpose and identify confirmed Bounded Contexts and Aggregate Roots. Then use $ddd-expert:tactical-design to question domain objects depth-first, apply the Capability Probe, record coherent Entity descriptions as they close, and confirm the integrated Aggregate Root before $ddd-expert:codify implements its definitions, Facts, Lifecycle State, behavior, Required Capabilities, and actual Domain Events.
